The '''Mosciives''' were a [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that inhabited the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Simocadia]]. They were distinguished from the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] only by their distinctive red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].
